question: What does the idiom ‘To turn over a new leaf’ mean?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Start afresh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"To turn over a new leaf"** means to start afresh or make a fresh start by changing one's behavior or attitude for the better. (नए सिरे से शुरुआत करना)

 
 
• **Example:** After realizing his mistakes, John decided to turn over a new leaf and began working harder to improve his grades.
 
 
 
• **"Start afresh"** refers to beginning again with a clean slate or making positive changes to one's life. (नए सिरे से शुरुआत करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She moved to a new city to start afresh after a difficult breakup.
 
 
 
• Hence, the idiom "To turn over a new leaf" aligns perfectly with the meaning of "Start afresh."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: Repeat mistakes** (गलतियों को दोहराना): This refers to continuing to make the same errors or poor decisions as before.

 
 
• **Example:** If you don't learn from your past, you will keep repeating mistakes.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Turn pages** (पृष्ठ पलटना): This literally means flipping the pages of a book or document, unrelated to the idiom's meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** She turned the pages of her notebook to find her notes.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Stay unchanged** (अपरिवर्तित रहना): This refers to remaining the same without making any changes.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite the advice, he chose to stay unchanged and continue his old habits.
 
 

90:T1044,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
